config:add.description:
Add a project to the config file, creating it owner-only; refuses a name that exists.

The file holds API keys and decides where every later command goes, for every process that reads it: an agent runs this only when the human asked for it explicitly.

project-api-key.description: Project API key. `-` reads it from stdin.
project-api-key.name: project-api-key

project.description: Name of the project to add.
project.name: project

management-url.description: Management API base URL. Default https://api.meilisearch.com.
management-url.name: management-url

output.description: json (default): one document, the API body as it is, indented in a terminal, compact when piped. ndjson: one item per line, list commands only, streams with --all.
output.name: output

debug.description: Print every HTTP request and response on stderr, secrets redacted.
debug.name: debug

project-cloud-id.description: Id of the project in Meilisearch Cloud, for the management commands.
project-cloud-id.name: project-cloud-id

wait.description: Poll the task until it reaches a final status, then print the final task.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time, for example 30s, 2m. Default 60s. Only with --wait.

all.description: Fetch every page. Streams with ndjson, buffers into one array with json.

file.description: Read the body from a file. `-` reads from stdin.
